en.name: ELCAN SpecterDR 1x/4x scope (TAN)
en.description: The SpecterDR (Dual Role) 1x/4x scope from Specter scope series designed by ELCAN has marked a breakthrough in the optic sight development by becoming the first variable scope that truly has two work modes, switching from 4x magnification to 1x in one touch. Also features a backup iron sight. TAN version.

po.name: Luneta 1x/4x ELCAN SpecterDR (TAN)
po.description: A mira SpecterDR (Dual Role) 1x/4x, da série Specter projetada pela ELCAN, representou um avanço no desenvolvimento de miras ópticas ao se tornar a primeira mira com ampliação variável que possui, de fato, dois modos de operação, permitindo alternar da ampliação de 4x para 1x com um único toque. Também possui uma mira mecânica de reserva. Versão TAN.

ru.name: Оптический прицел ELCAN "SpecterDR 1x/4x" (TAN)
ru.description: Оптический прицел Specter SpecterDR (Dual Role) 1x/4x производства компании ELCAN. Новое слово в проектировании оптических прицелов. Первый в мире оптический прицел с действительно двумя режимами работы. Переключается с 4-х кратного увеличения на 1-но кратное в одно движение. Также оснащён запасным открытым прицелом. Версия TAN.
